answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because harbor only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, mirror is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
